items.text: Deadline colours: steps due within 5 days turn orange, overdue ones red. They show on the step, at the top of the project's sidebar, and as a dot on the project tab.
Calendar tab now has an overview of all projects: which one needs attention first, and every deadline across projects in one list. Click one to jump to the step.
You can run several timers at once. Starting a new one no longer stops the others.
Aquarium: the shop now has a Back to tank button, so you can return to your fish.
Project tabs: keep several roadmaps side by side. Double-click a tab to rename it.
Save as… saves the open project to a file you can open anywhere, and Import… adds a project from a file.
Target dates: set a finish day for a step in its notes, or click a day in the Calendar. Overdue steps turn red.
Aquarium: a small pixel fish tank you can drag around. Finish steps and track time to earn pearls, then trade them for rarer fish (up to 7).
This What's new window, shown after each update. Open it any time from the link at the top.
The timer no longer takes space at the top. Hover the ▶ / ■ button next to a step to see the running time.
Click a step to open its notes. They support Markdown and LaTeX math like Obsidian.
Drag any step to reorder it, or use the ↑ / ↓ buttons.
Check for updates button, and the app version next to the name.
+ Add main step for top-level steps, and a small example tree on first run.
Collapse or expand a branch with its chevron; the label now opens notes.
